verdict.rationale: Turso documents point-in-time recovery for restoring a database to a specific moment, such as after a dropped table. The durability page lists per-tier figures alongside 11-nines durability, and Pro/Enterprise customers can use their own S3 buckets. Manual dumps via the CLI give a self-serve export path, but the evidence never shows a visible or configurable backup schedule and never shows the exact self-serve restore workflow (CLI/API/dashboard). missing for 10: visible/configurable backup schedule or retention settings, explicit self-serve restore command or UI documentation, independent/hands-on corroboration of restores.
